finding_info_list.title: Posture alert det-eb-001: acme-internal-exports in acme-prod made publicly readable
finding_info_list.desc: The cloud posture product reported that the bucket policy on acme-internal-exports (account 111122223333) now grants read access to any principal. The change was made with the deploy-ci access key. No change request is linked. Assigned to SOC Tier 2 for triage.
